newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese 11 mos tax receipts rise 9.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese 11 mos tax receipts rise 9.8 pct.

text.p: Tax revenues rose 9.8 percent to 3,365 billion escudos in the first 11 months of the year, the Portuguese Finance Ministry said in a statement.
Corporation tax showed the largest increase, rising 36.4 percent to 390 billion.
Income tax returns rose 8.4 percent to 954.7 billion, while Value Added Tax (VAT) was up 7.9 percent at 1,042 billion.
The government has said it expects the budget deficit to narrow to four percent of gross domestic product (GDP) in 1996 from 4.9 percent last year.
